workflows.name: Opening and Switching Windows
workflows.description: Two shortcuts that put another window in front of this one. Both hand the keyboard to whatever they open, so when you are done, click this window to carry on — GNOME does not let an application take the keyboard back by itself.

steps.heading: Open a terminal
steps.description: The one shortcut worth knowing before any other. The terminal opens in front of this window and takes the keyboard with it; click back here when you have had a look.

steps.heading: Switch between open windows
steps.description: Hold Alt and press Tab to move between windows. This is the last step on purpose: it moves the keyboard to whatever you switch to, so click this window afterwards to return.
